description: Track up to 20 new keywords for one of your applications in a single call. Each keyword triggers an immediate ranking fetch. Already-tracked keywords return a per-keyword error in `results`; previously removed keywords are reactivated automatically. Use app_id from list_applications results.

app_id.description: The application internal ID (numeric, from list_applications results)

country.description: ISO country code (e.g., US, FR, DE)

lang.description: BCP-47 language-region code (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE)

store.description: App store: GPLAY (Google Play) or ITUNES (App Store)

name: track_keywords
